SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Paper CRAFT be able to;. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. make items using folding techniques for problem solving
2. make items using paper folding techniques for fun items of their choice, work. art work Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. make items using folding techniques for problem solving
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make items using folding techniques for problem solving. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. make items using paper folding techniques for fun items of their choice, work. art work Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make items using paper folding techniques for fun items of their choice, work. art work Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
